ABOUT.TITLE: Pioneering Sustainable
ABOUT.LEAD: WasteZero is a community-driven technology platform dedicated to solving the global waste crisis through intelligent coordination, behavioral science, and real-time logistics.
ABOUT.STORY_DESC1: WasteZero began as a small pilot project aimed at reducing landfill dependency in urban neighborhoods. We realized that the biggest barrier to effective recycling wasn't a lack of will, but a lack of infrastructure and coordination.
ABOUT.STORY_DESC2: By leveraging mobile technology and a passionate community of volunteers, we've built an ecosystem where every piece of waste is tracked, sorted, and redirected to its optimal end-point—whether that's a recycling plant, a composting facility, or a creative reuse center.
ABOUT.VISION_DESC: A future where "waste" as a concept no longer exists—replaced by a circular economy where every material is recognized as a valuable resource and handled with precision and care.
ABOUT.MISSION_DESC: To empower communities with the technical tools and coordination systems needed to achieve zero-waste goals efficiently, transparently, and rewardingly.
ABOUT.TEAM_DESC: A diverse collective of environmentalists, engineers, and community leaders dedicated to a greener future.
ABOUT.TEAM_DESC_NANDAN: Visionary leader driving digital transformation and sustainable global ecosystems.
ABOUT.TEAM_DESC_ANJALI: Pioneering green energy initiatives and carbon-neutral strategies across global operations.
ABOUT.TEAM_DESC_RAFEE: Leading the deployment of AI-driven waste optimization and smart logistics.
ABOUT.TEAM_DESC_VIKRAM: Leading global digital transformation and ESG strategies to drive carbon-neutral operations at scale.
ABOUT.CTA_DESC: Join our growing community and start making a real impact on your environment today.

SERVICES.FAQ_DESC: Getting started with WasteZero is easy, but here are some things you might want to know.
SERVICES.FAQ_Q1: What types of waste do you handle?
SERVICES.FAQ_A1: We handle recyclable materials (plastics, paper, glass, metals), organic/compostable waste, and even certain hazardous household items like batteries and e-waste. Specific guidelines are available when you schedule a pickup.
SERVICES.FAQ_Q2: Is there a fee for waste collection?
SERVICES.FAQ_A2: Standard recycling pickups for citizens are currently free, supported by our partnerships with sustainable organizations. Premium/commercial bulk pickups may incur a small maintenance fee.
SERVICES.FAQ_A3: Every volunteer undergoes a brief background check and an orientation session before being allowed to handle pickups or participate in community drives. We prioritize safety and professionalism.
